Groups into Single-Elimination |prizepool= |tournaments=4on4 |entrance= |website= |sdate=2000-01-21 |edate=2000-04-29 |twitch= |teamfirst=Flaming Fist |teamfirstflag=se |teamsecond=CAPSLOCK |teamsecondflag=se |teamthird=Euthanasia |teamthirdflag=se |teamthird2=Clan Malfunction |teamthird2flag=fi |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 }} == Introduction == * Round: Villains 2 - Group 4 * Match: {{Flag/fi}} [[Clan Malfunction]] vs {{Flag/dk}} [[Chopstick Ninjas]] * Date: 2000-02-06 == Match report == === DM3 === CMF: 183 - CN: 116
[[Image:Cmf-cn-dm3-1.jpg|320px]]
Map pick by Clan Malfunction.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/d/d7/Cmf_vs_cn_dm3_1-peksi.qwz peksi (CMF)]

"Like every game on dm3, this one starts with the fights about the powerups too. Some telefragging at the beginning and CN managed to get the first Pent. The Quad felt pretty lonely for about 30 seconds or so. It took some time until a player noticed that it was still there :) The Quad was also taken by CN so was the Ring. CMF lost the powerup fight at the start but that doesn't make a whole game of course. With 2 minutes being played it was 15 - 6 to CMF. I don't see a lot of things being worth reporting because i wasn't able to see a lot of tactics in the game. At least no suceeding tactics. CN seemed to control the YA a bit at the beginning and the RA room was under CMF's hands. CMF did better though and they lead 89 - 37 at minute 10. Like i said there didn't happen a lot until the 12th minute. It really was CN's chance for a comeback. None of CMF's players had an RL but all 4 of CN's did. Until the minute of 15 they decreased CMF's leading down to 115 - 91. Another big fight at Pent took place and CMF won it with having weapons in their rows again. They got the important locations under control again, increased their leading up to the final score being 183 - 116 to CMF. ." -Andy === DM3-2 === CMF: 191 - CN: 103
[[Image:Cmf-cn-dm3-2.jpg|320px]]
Map pick by Chopstick Ninjas.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/4/40/Cmf_vs_cn_dm3_2_peksi.qwz peksi (CMF)]

"In game2 CN had a better start, not just powerupwise, no they did more frags at the beginning and got some locations under their control. RA seemed to be CN's and there were big fights about that but mostly CN won. The score was closer for a longer time of the game. 23 - 22 to CN after 3 minutes. Until minute 8 nothing great happened just a lot of frags by both teams and the score was 62 - 61. Then CMF got control over the map and it looked worse for CN who showed a great game until that minute. In the Pent fight at minute 15 CMF really seemed to be in better position. When i remember correctly they had 3 of their players outside and all attacks by CN have been defeated. But a CN player just fell down to Pent and got it :) It didn't help them anyway. About 5 players have been killed for the pent attack and the CN player didn't have an RL so he wasn't able to get control again. CMF got everything back again and the final score was 191 - 103 to CMF. Both teams did good games and game2 could also have been won by CN." -Andy == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** CMF: 374 ** CN: 219 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
